en.description:
It's midnight, and you're working the graveyard shift - literally. But tonight, the dead won't stay buried!

Skeletons rise from their graves on both sides of the cemetery, shambling toward you with murderous intent. Tap the left or right side of the screen to strike down the undead before they reach you. Strike the wrong side and you lose your chance to stop that skeleton. Let one through, and your shift ends... permanently.

FEATURES
- Simple one-tap controls: tap left or right to swing your sword
- Skeletons get faster with every kill, so stay sharp
- A pixel-art graveyard at night
- Chase your best score and compete on the Game Center leaderboard
- Apple Watch app included, so you can take your shift on your wrist
- Free to play with ads
en.releaseNotes: Ad banner improvements and a developer website link in the app listing.
en.subtitle: Slash the undead, survive
